name: Shinogi Chess Club
source:
At Yoshino High School, all that matters is your skill in Shinogi Chess. As the Spring Championships approach, Himiko Masaki investigates a dangerous organization and discovers a powerful ability. Climb the ranks, make new friends (and enemies), and search for answers in Shinogi Chess Club!

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1840060/Shinogi_Chess_Club]Steam[/url]]
